name: Hotham
title: A warrior from Aroer and father of David's mighty men
summary: Hotham is a biblical figure mentioned in the Books of Chronicles. There are two individuals with this name: one who was the son of Heber from the tribe of Asher, and another known as the Aroerite, father of Shama and Jehiel, who were among David's mighty warriors. He is best known as the father of two of David's brave men.

keyEvents.title: Hotham in the genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Hotham is mentioned as one of the sons of Heber in the tribal register of Asher, among the brave warriors and heads of their families.

keyEvents.title: Hotham's sons among David's mighty men
keyEvents.description: Hotam the Aroerite is the father of Shama and Jehiel, both mentioned among David's mighty warriors in the list of his heroes.

keyEvents.title: The Heroes of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Hotam and his descendants are counted among the heads of their clans, brave warriors, and prominent leaders, recorded in the genealogical records.

keyEvents.title: David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: The list of David's mighty men includes the sons of Hotam the Aroerite, showing the family's military significance in David's kingdom.
